testimonials.author: Dr. Priya & Thomas Mathew
testimonials.quote: We bought our first Norway Spruce from Raave in 2012. It has been 14 Christmases now, and it still looks as breathtaking as the first day we opened the box. Raave is truly part of our family tradition.

testimonials.author: Ananya Deshmukh
testimonials.quote: The 3000-LED cluster lights transformed our living room into a winter fairytale wonderland! The staff at Bandra were so warm and guided us through every step of assembly.

testimonials.author: Vikram Joseph
testimonials.quote: The quality is unmistakable. No shedding, no bent branches, and the gold bauble set has heirloom quality weight. Raave’s Evergreen is leagues ahead of anything else available in India.
